seo.metaTitle: Willits Wrongful Death Attorney Connection | LawProactive
seo.metaDescription: Lost a loved one in Willits? LawProactive is a free service that connects Mendocino County families with an independent wrongful death attorney.

hero.subtitle: When someone in Willits dies because another person or company was careless, the family left behind has a civil claim under California law. LawProactive connects you, free of charge, with an independent attorney who can explain what that claim may cover.

about.title: Willits Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Willits sits where Rt 101 meets Rt 20, and for a town of 4,861 people, a single loss is felt on every block of Main Street. In the most recent final crash year, 2025, public records show one injury collision, one person hurt, and no traffic deaths within city limits. That count is a relief, but it does not erase what families face when a death does happen, whether on the highway approach, on S Main Street, at a job site, or in a medical setting. California law gives a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children the first right to bring a wrongful death claim, with certain dependents and heirs able to step in when they are not present. The deadline is generally two years from the date of death, and it shrinks when a public agency may be responsible. LawProactive is not a law firm. We simply connect Mendocino County families with an independent attorney who handles these cases on contingency, so there is no fee unless something is recovered.

whyChoose.title: Why Willits Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who has standing
items.desc: California limits who may bring a wrongful death action, starting with the spouse or domestic partner and children, then certain dependents and heirs. The attorney you are matched with can sort out where your family fits before anything is filed.

items.title: The two-year clock is watched closely
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is shorter when a city, county or state agency is involved. Early contact helps preserve that right.

items.title: Every category of loss is accounted for
items.desc: Funeral and burial costs, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship and guidance are all recognized under California law. A contingency-fee attorney pursues these without charging a fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: My relative was killed on Rt 101 just outside Willits. Does it matter that it wasn't inside the city?
items.answer: Location within or outside city limits does not change your family's right to bring a claim. What matters is who was at fault and whether a public entity, such as the agency responsible for the highway, may share responsibility. If it does, a claim must be presented to that entity on a much shorter timeline than the usual two years, so it is wise to speak with an attorney soon.

items.question: The driver is facing criminal charges. Do we have to wait for that case to end?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action and runs separately from any criminal prosecution in Mendocino County. The two cases can proceed at the same time, and the outcome of one does not decide the other. Your attorney can explain how evidence from the criminal matter may still be useful.

items.question: Who in our family is allowed to file, and what can be recovered?
items.answer: California gives first priority to the surviving spouse or domestic partner and the children of the person who died; certain dependents and heirs may qualify when those relatives are not present. Recoverable losses include funeral and burial expenses, the financial support the person would have contributed, and the loss of their love, companionship and guidance. An independent attorney can review your family's specific situation at no cost through LawProactive.
